FX-SPEED-001.says: The settings as they start: about the middle, #000000, count 120, thickness 1.5, inner 150, inner jitter 40, angle jitter 50, seed 0, hold 2, opacity 100. Every line starts at least 90 pixels from the centre, further than any pixel of the small drawing: the solid, untouched, at frame 0 and frame 4.

FX-SPEED-002.says: Inner 0, the rest as they start: 120 thin lines reach the centre, and every pixel of the solid is greyed, none fully black. With hold 2, frame 1 is frame 0; frame 2 draws new lines, and frame 4 new again.

FX-SPEED-003.says: Count 12, thickness 10, inner 2: twelve wide lines, jittered, rushing in to 2 pixels or so from the centre; frame 1 is frame 0, frames 2 and 4 are new lines.

FX-SPEED-004.says: FX-SPEED-003 with inner jitter 0 and angle jitter 0: the lines exactly every 30 degrees, the first straight up, so columns 7 and 8, either side of the lines straight up and straight down, are darkened alike in rows 0 to 2 and 7 to 9, and the pixels nearest the centre, under 1.5 pixels from it, untouched.

FX-SPEED-005.says: FX-SPEED-004 with inner 5 and inner jitter 100: each line starts anywhere from the centre to 10 pixels out, so some pixels under 4.5 pixels from the centre are reached, which inner jitter 0 leaves untouched, and some further out are not.

FX-SPEED-006.says: FX-SPEED-004 with angle jitter 100: each line moved off its even place by up to half a spacing, 15 degrees either way.

FX-SPEED-007.says: FX-SPEED-003 with thickness 30: wedges three times as wide, darkening more of the solid, none less.

FX-SPEED-008.says: FX-SPEED-003 with thickness 0: each line a hairline, its softened edge alone showing, so no pixel is more than half way to black.

FX-SPEED-009.says: Count 4, thickness 30, inner 0, both jitters 0: four wedges, up, right, down and left, a cross, black at its arms' ends; the diagonal pixels (9, 6) to (11, 8) and (6, 3) to (4, 1), between the arms, untouched, and the four pixels about the centre greyed, where the arms' softened edges meet.

FX-SPEED-010.says: Count 1000, thickness 30, inner 0: the lines overlap everywhere, so every pixel 4 or more pixels from the centre is black.

FX-SPEED-011.says: FX-SPEED-003 with seed 7.9, which counts as 7: lines of their own, not FX-SPEED-003's.

FX-SPEED-012.says: FX-SPEED-003 with hold 1: new lines every frame, so frame 1 is FX-SPEED-003's frame 2 and frame 2 is its frame 4.

FX-SPEED-013.says: FX-SPEED-003 with hold 100: the same lines on every frame, frame 4 is frame 0.

FX-SPEED-014.says: FX-SPEED-003 with opacity 50: each pixel half as far toward black.

FX-SPEED-015.says: FX-SPEED-003 in #3a6fd8, a blue: the same lines, blue.

FX-SPEED-016.says: FX-SPEED-015 with the colour written in capitals, #3A6FD8: the same.

FX-SPEED-017.says: FX-SPEED-003 about the middle of the left edge, centre 0, 50: the lines rush in toward the left edge, and the two pixels at its middle, (0, 4) and (0, 5), inside every line's start, are untouched.

FX-SPEED-018.says: FX-SPEED-003 with count keyed from 4 at frame 0 to 20 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 has four lines, frame 1 eight, frame 2, at 12, is FX-SPEED-003's frame 2, and frame 4 has twenty.

FX-SPEED-019.says: FX-SPEED-003 with opacity keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 0 is the solid; frame 2 is held at 100 and is FX-SPEED-003's frame 2.

FX-SPEED-020.says: FX-SPEED-003 moved three pixels right: the lines are worked in the drawing's own space, so they move with it; the three columns left of it are empty.

FX-SPEED-021.says: FX-SPEED-003 on Noise's card rather than the solid: the same lines, drawn only inside the covering; the empty pixels stay empty, the soft right edge keeps its half covering, and the black patch stays black.

FX-SPEED-022.says: Count 3, below 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-023.says: Thickness 31, above 30. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-024.says: Inner -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-025.says: Inner jitter 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-026.says: Hold 0, below 1. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-027.says: Centre 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-028.says: Opacity keyed to 150 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPEED-029.says: Colour "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
